body:
#### PR description:


This PR adds `#include <cmath>` and uses `std::floor` for the two calls (`BinX`, `BinY`).
No change in behaviour is expected.
Since `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-14-2300`, the `check-headers` IB job fails for
`Alignment/MuonAlignmentAlgorithms/interface/FlatOccupancy.h`
title: Add missing <cmath> include in FlatOccupancy.h
